def vary(example, rng):
    # Keep the two-column, sparse-marker structure while varying height and marker location/color.
    h = rng.randint(3, 8)
    w = 2
    grid = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    # one or two colored markers, as in the sparse-object family
    n = rng.randint(1, min(2, h))
